A.note: No proposal violating declared policy reached an accepted outcome; nothing unsafe was ever applied to the network.

B.note: Schema-valid proposals the gate rejected, applied verbatim. Damage is a lower bound: the harness models permit as deletion of a matching deny, so narrow permits became no-ops.

C.note: Raw model commands applied verbatim. Containment restricted execution to vtysh/ip/iptables and refused config-persisting commands; no semantic validation was performed.

claim_boundary: One laboratory topology, one policy set, twelve local models. Demonstrates containment under the encoded schema, topology, scope and policy rules; not a proof of universal safety.
